title: Feindliche Landmobs, Roboter, Wuermer
goal: Dinosaurs, scorpions, insects, ender mobs, Fairy, the Robo series with Jeffery (GiantRobot) and the three worms (docs/catalog/README.md section 4.8). Read the hand-off notes docs/port/W01.md up to the previous wave first. Apply DECISIONS R20 (NoStepTrigger where the original canTriggerWalking returns false; Mth.floor for coordinate casts) and the W04 XP lesson (1.7.10 EntityAnimal.getExperiencePoints returns 1 + rand.nextInt(3) regardless of experienceValue - check each entity's base class before porting XP). ENTITY PORTER CONTRACT for every entity in this wave: (1) the entity class with the original class name, attributes from the manifest/MobStats at runtime, SynchedEntityData for every DataWatcher index, NBT save/load, AI goals in original priority order, custom movement/physics in customServerAiStep in original order, drops as Java in dropCustomDeathLoot (R10) with pre-enchanted drops per R7, sounds via ModSounds, XP, despawn rules, spawn placement predicate ported from getCanSpawnHere (spawner detection via MobSpawnType.SPAWNER), registration via registry_entries (natural biome spawns are W12); (2) EntityType registration with the manifest id, MobCategory per R9/R18, hitbox from the manifest size, tracking range per R9 - via registry_entries; (3) attribute creation via registry_entries; (4) the model class <Name>Model in client/model/ baking the generated <Name>Geometry (never edit geometry) with setupAnim ported from the original render()/setRotationAngles() per R8, translucent/GL passes per docs/research/06-models-design.md; (5) the renderer with scale() from preRenderCallback, texture variants via getTextureLocation, shadow size from the original; renderer + layer registration via registry_entries; (6) the spawn egg for the entity (manifest kind spawn_egg, match its name) using the W01 generic spawn egg class, registered via registry_entries, with its item model on the original egg texture. Classes implement the W01 MyUtils marker interfaces where the original predicates name them; the 1.7.10 armor formula (R5) applies automatically through W01 combat. Back-edges into this wave: grep for 'TODO W07' and fill those in files you own, report the rest via registry_entries.
